title: thymus patavinus var. graveolens
intro: Thymus patavinus var. graveolens, commonly known as Italian thyme, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This herb is valued for its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its numerous health benefits, including the relief of respiratory issues and its potential anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Italian thyme include its ability to act as an expectorant, a carminative, and an antiseptic, making it effective in treating coughs, digestive issues, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Italian thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
